name: ols/php-fts
description: A self-contained full-text search engine in pure PHP. No extensions, no external services, no dependencies. Trigram indexing, BM25+IDF scoring, filters. Ideal for shared hosting and small VPS.

suggest.ext-intl: Enables full Unicode NFC normalization for NFD input handling
suggest.ext-posix: Enables detection of locks left behind by a dead process; without it, stale locks are only reclaimed once they exceed the maximum lock age
